exposure: abdominal aorta reconstruction (aneurysmectomy and aorto-bilateral iliac artery bypass)
cohort: A 35-year-old pregnant woman with Marfan syndrome at 37 weeks' gestation presenting with an abdominal aortic aneurysm.
finding: A one-stage procedure involving Caesarean section and abdominal aortic aneurysm repair was successfully performed in a pregnant woman with Marfan syndrome.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was successfully performed as part of a one-stage procedure to treat an abdominal aortic aneurysm in a patient with Marfan syndrome.
